decision: Kept the export as it is, CSV only. The accepted ADR 0011 in mira-app forbids adding XLSX until it is superseded, and Mira's "make Haruto happy" message doesn't mention XLSX or supersede it.

recorded.info: Added a decision section. It records keep_as_is and the reason: ADR 0011 (CSV only, Accepted) is still in force. It also records Mira's message ("Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy"), which does not supersede ADR 0011. Open item: XLSX needs Mira's explicit words and a new superseding ADR, and there are non-XLSX ways to help Haruto, such as help opening the CSV in Excel.
